metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from Agulhas Labs. agent-cost: a report of where your tokens went. orchestration: a team of agents sized to the job. cache-guard: a warning before the one message that costs twenty times the rest.

plugins.name: agent-cost
plugins.description: Shows where your Claude Code tokens went, from the transcripts already on your disk: for your own sessions and for subagents separately: totals by model, the costliest projects and sessions, how concentrated the spend is, single-call turns, cold-cache turns, what fills the contexts you keep re-sending, and what every context pays before it does any work. It changes nothing and nothing leaves your machine.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Run Claude Code like a lead with a team: cheap models do the specified work, an expensive one designs and reviews, and nothing is done until a command proves it. Measure what it saves with the agent-cost plugin.

plugins.name: cache-guard
plugins.description: Warns once before a message that will cost far more than usual: a large Claude Code context whose prompt cache has expired, or a model or effort change that resets it. Shows the estimated cost, and offers a handoff file written by a cheap model in the background so you can /clear instead.
